title: Add a CLI option without breaking scripts
prompt: A CLI uses Node util.parseArgs in strict mode with options {"format":{"type":"string","short":"f","default":"text"}}. Users need repeatable --tag / -t values, including duplicates in order. With no tags, do not introduce a tag key. Return the complete replacement parseArgs options object in the field options. Also submit a regression test in regression: {argv: [argument strings], values: {exact expected options}}. Make it catch an implementation that keeps only the last tag, not just exercise a happy path. Do not return JavaScript.

checks.label: The proposed regression test passes the reference and fails a last-tag-only implementation
